scope: Lexical source-only candidates: self-moving cost and relation check anywhere in same file. Different effects often make these valid; pair actual registration/cost/operation before inferring defects.

candidates.name: Crewal Meeting
candidates.text: Send 1 face-up Continuous Trap you control to the GY; Place 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie monster from your Deck, banishment or GY face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Crewal" card or Zombie monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Crewal Meeting" once per turn.

candidates.name: Aquamarine Pisaster Giga
candidates.text: If you control a WATER Aqua monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Aquamarine Pisaster Giga" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Aquamarine Pisaster Giga" once per turn. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Aquamarine" monster from your Deck, except "Aquamarine Pisaster Giga". If this card is banished from your GY: You can target 1 of your banished "Aquamarine" monsters, except "Aquamarine Pisaster Giga"; add it to your hand.

candidates.name: Checkmate in Aldrez
candidates.text: If you control an "Aldrez" monster: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; negate its effects, then, if you control the monster with the highest ATK on the field, you can destroy all monsters your opponent controls, except that target. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Aldrez" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it. If you control an "Aldrez" Xyz Monster, you can activate this card from your hand. You can only activate 1 "Checkmate in Aldrez" per turn.

candidates.name: Talismandrake Arms United
candidates.text: Discard 1 card; place up to 2 "Talismandrake" Pendulum Monsters from your Deck or face-up Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zones. If a Pyro Fusion Monster is Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 of those monsters; equip 1 "Talismandrake Arms" Spell/Trap from your Deck to it as if it were equipped by that Spell/Trap's effect. You can only use each effect of "Talismandrake Arms United" once per turn.

candidates.name: Fruteopia
candidates.text: This card’s name becomes “Fruteonia” while face-up on the field. You can only use 1 of the following effects of “Fruteopia” per turn, and only once that turn. When this card is activated: You can add 1 “Frute” monster or 1 “Fruteification” from your Deck or banishment to your hand. If a WATER Ritual Monster(s) you control leaves the field by card effect: You can send this card to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 of those monsters. You can banish this card from your GY; all WATER monsters you control gain 400 ATK this turn for each Defense Position monster your opponent controls.

candidates.name: Curryboh
candidates.text: If you take damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, for the rest of this turn, if you would take damage, you gain that much LP instead. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster on the field; gain LP equal to its ATK. You can only activate 1 "Curryboh" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

candidates.name: Bookkeeper of Crying Chaos
candidates.text: (Quick effect): You can discard this card, then target 1 Level 3 or lower Zombie monster in your GY; Special Summon it. If you control a Level 6 or higher "Crying Chaos" Synchro Monster: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 3 Zombie monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Bookkeeper of Crying Chaos" once per turn.

candidates.name: Branching to Guidance
candidates.text: Reveal 1 monster in your hand that can be Normal Summoned/Set; Special Summon 1 "Guidance Token" in Defense Position, with the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as the revealed monster, also, its name becomes the revealed monster's name in addition to its original name. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster in your GY that can be Normal Summoned/Set; Special Summon 1 "Guidance Token" in Defense Position, with the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as the targeted monster, also, its name becomes the targeted monster's name in addition to its original name. You can only use 1 "Branching to Guidance" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

candidates.name: Phantasm Spiral Ensnarement
candidates.text: If all monsters you control are Normal Monsters: Change 1 face-up monster on the field to face-down Defense Position. If "Umi" is on the field, you can activate this card from your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Normal Monster you control; equip 1 "Phantasm Spiral" Equip Spell from your Deck to that monster. You can only use this effect of "Phantasm Spiral Ensnarement" once per turn.

candidates.name: Nautical Backwashing & Oceanic Waves
candidates.text: Target 1 "Nautica" monster in your GY; return that target to the hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, your opponent Normal or Special Summons 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, but its ATK becomes 0. You can banish this card from your GY; place 3 Aqua monsters from your GY on the bottom of your Deck in any order, then draw 1 card. You can only use 1 effect of "Nautical Backwashing & Oceanic Waves" per turn and only once that turn.

candidates.name: Hallo-Ween! Basket of Treats
candidates.text: Tribute 1 "Hallo" or "Ween" monster from your hand or field; then apply the appropriate effect based on which monster you Tributed. ● "Hallo": Special Summon 1 "Ween" monster from your Deck or GY. ● "Ween": Special Summon 1 "Hallo" monster from your Deck or hand. You can banish this card from your GY, except the turn it was sent there, then target 1 Level 6 or higher monster your opponent controls; inflict 500 damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original Level, then destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Hallo-Ween! Basket of Treats" once per turn.

candidates.name: Takama No Hara
candidates.text: Discard 2 cards including a Spirit monster, then, add up to 2 Spirit monsters with different Levels from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Spirit monster you control; it cannot return to the hand by card effect until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Takama No Hara" once per turn.

candidates.name: Aldrez Battery
candidates.text: Add 1 "Aldrez" monster from your Deck to your hand, also, you cannot declare attacks for the rest of this turn, except with "Aldrez" monsters. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monsters your opponent controls; its ATK becomes 0, and if it does, you can have 1 "Aldrez" monster you control gain that lost ATK. You can only activate 1 "Aldrez Battery" per turn.

candidates.name: Phantasm Spiral Shrine
candidates.text: Place 1 "Umi" from your Deck or GY face-up on your field, it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects while you control no Effect Monsters. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 5 "Phantasm Spiral" Spell/Trap Cards and/or Normal Monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Phantasm Spiral Shrine" effect per turn and only once that turn.

candidates.name: Symphonic Warrior Mettronomo
candidates.text: If you control a face-up "Symph Amplifire", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can Tribute 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster you control; Special Summon "Symphonic Warrior" monsters from your Deck with different names who's total Level equal the Level of the Tributed monster. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster you control; increase or decrease its Level by 1. You can only use each effect of "Symphonic Warrior Mettronomo" once per turn.

candidates.name: Incarnation of Nephthys
candidates.text: If a card is Tributed or destroyed: You can reveal this card and 1 "Nephthys" Ritual Monster from your hand, then send 1 "Nephthys" Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck to the GY; destroy this card, and if you do, apply the sent card's activation effect that Ritual Summons a monster. If a "Nephthys" Ritual Monster is Special Summoned while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card from your GY; destroy cards your opponent controls up to the number of monsters Tributed for the Ritual Summon of the Ritual Monster. During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Nephthys" monster in your GY; shuffle them into your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Incarnation of Nephthys" once per turn.

candidates.name: Sylvan Intervention
candidates.text: Send this card to the GY, then target 3 "Sylvan" monsters in your GY; Place 2 of them on top of your Deck in any order, then Special Summon the other one. You can only use this effect of "Sylvan Intervention" once per turn. If this card is excavated by the effect of a "Sylvan" card, send it to the GY. If a Plant monster(s) you control would be destroyed by a card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

candidates.name: Sylvan Duchessprout
candidates.text:
1 "Sylvan" monster
You can only Special Summon "Sylvan Duchessprout" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, then send any excavated Plant monsters to the GY, also place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Sylvan" monster you control, and declare a Level from 1 to 8; it becomes that Level.

candidates.name: Fierce Snake of the Swamp
candidates.text: You can discard this card; send 1 WATER Reptile monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Fierce Snake of the Swamp". If this card is Special Summoned, or if this card is sent to the GY by a card that mentions "Terrifying Dark Swamp", except by the effect of "Fierce Snake of the Swamp": You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. If "Terrifying Dark Swamp" is on your field or GY, your opponent cannot activate the target or its effects in response to this effect. You can only use each effect of "Fierce Snake of the Swamp" once per turn.

candidates.name: Sparkling Snake of the Swamp
candidates.text: You can discard this card; send 1 WATER Reptile monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Sparkling Snake of the Swamp". If this card is Special Summoned, or if this card is sent to the GY by a card that mentions "Terrifying Dark Swamp", except by the effect of "Sparkling Snake of the Swamp": You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. If "Terrifying Dark Swamp" is on your field or GY, your opponent cannot activate the target's effect in response to this effect. You can only use each effect of "Sparkling Snake of the Swamp" once per turn.

candidates.name: Aquamarine Nautilus
candidates.text:
1 "Aquamarine" monster + 1 WATER Aqua monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Aquamarine" card from your hand or Deck to the GY. (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 WATER Aqua monster you control; your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Aquamarine monster from your GY, except "Aquamarine Nautilus". You can only use each effect of "Aquamarine Nautilus" once per turn.

candidates.name: Killamity Showdown
candidates.text: Target 1 monster your opponent controls with the same Type or Attribute as a monster attached to a monster you control; attach it to 1 Rank 12 Xyz Monster you control as Xyz Material. If you control a Rank 12 "Killamity" Xyz Monster: You can banish this card from your GY; negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Killamity Showdown" once per turn.

candidates.name: Fruteaching
candidates.text: Special Summon 1 “Frute” monster from your hand or GY in face-up or face-down Defense Position, or, if you control "Fruteonia", you can Special Summon 1 "Frute" monster from your Deck instead in face-up or face-down Defense Position. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster you control; change it to either face-up or face-down Defense Position. You can only use each effect of “Fruteaching” once per turn.

candidates.name: Checked in Aldrez
candidates.text: If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) while you control an "Aldrez" monster: Send 1 "Aldrez" monster from your Deck to the GY; send 1 monster your opponent controls to the GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Aldrez" card in your GY or banishment, except "Checked in Aldrez"; add it to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Checked in Aldrez" per turn.

candidates.name: Galactican Battle Grounds
candidates.text: When this card is activated: You can activate 1 "Galactican Battle Station" from your Deck, GY, or banishment. If your "Galactica" monster battles, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step. If your "Galactica" card would be destroyed by your opponent's card effect, or, if you would take battle damage, you can banish this card you control instead.

candidates.name: Fruteification
candidates.text: When this card is activated, you can also target 1 non-Ritual "Frute" monster in your GY, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot target a monster to activate this effect of "Fruteification"; Special Summon the targeted monster in face-down Defense Position (if any), also, Ritual Summon 1 WATER Ritual Monster from your hand or GY by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 WATER Ritual Monster from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Fruteification" once per Duel.

candidates.name: Arckcestial Descend
candidates.text: Take 1 Level 4 or lower "Arckcestial" monster from your Deck and either add it to your hand or send it to the GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase, if you control a Synchro or Xyz "Arckcestial" monster: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Arckcestial" monster from your GY in Defense Position. If this card is discarded to the GY: You can Set this card. You can only use each effect of "Arckcestial Descend" once per turn.

candidates.name: Aeloria in Depraevity
candidates.text: (This card is always treated as an "Eldora" card.) Activate this card by targeting 1 Effect Monster you control; activate 1 "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" from your Deck, then Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster with the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF as that target and with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap). ● Cannot be destroyed by card effects. ● During the turn "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" was destroyed by your opponent's card effect while you controlled this card (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; activate 1 "Galactican Battle Station" from your hand, Deck or GY.

candidates.name: Charmelia Elysia
candidates.text: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; Ritual Summon 1 "Charmelia" Ritual Monster from your hand by Tributing monsters from your hand, Deck, or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster and/or sending "Charmelia" Continuous Spell/Trap Cards you control to the GY for every 4 Levels. If this card is Tributed for a Ritual Summon: You can place this card on the bottom of your Deck, then Special Summon 1 "Charmelia" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Charmelia Elysia" once per turn.

candidates.name: Sorceress of Fire
candidates.text: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can shuffle up to 2 "Phlogist" Spell/ Trap Cards from your GY or banishment into the Deck; Special Summon this card. (Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then pay any amount of LP in multiples of 300; send 1 monster that lists "Phlogiston Dragon" in its text from your Deck to the GY. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters. You can only use this effect of "Sorceress of Fire" once per turn.

candidates.name: Wyvernal Myops
candidates.text: You can banish 1 Insect monster from your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 WIND Insect monster from your hand. If this card is in your GY, and you control a "Wyvernal" Fusion monster (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY and target 1 card your opponent controls; Negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Wyvernal Myops" once per turn.

candidates.name: Red-Eyes Gearfried, the Iron Knight
candidates.text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red-Eyes" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon Link Monsters for the rest of this turn. A monster equipped with this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card is in the GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 5 other "Red-Eyes" cards on your field, GY, or banishment; shuffle them into the Deck then, if you shuffled "Red-Eyes Black Dragon", you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Gearfried, the Iron Knight" once per turn.

candidates.name: Red-Eyes Roar
candidates.text: Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Red-Eyes Roar" per turn); once " O Add 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your Deck to your hand. e Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip 1 level 4 or lower "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY to it. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Fiend Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by using Monster Cards in your hand or field as Fusion Material. You can only use this effect of "Red-Eyes Roar" once per turn.

candidates.name: The Orcustograph
candidates.text: 1 DARK Tuner + 1 non-Tuner DARK monster If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished "Orcust" monsters; Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY; negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "The Orcustograph" once per turn.

candidates.name: Oracle of the Grand Blue
candidates.text:
2 "Grand Blue" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, then, if this card is pointing to a "Grand Blue" monster, you can destroy 1 face-up card your opponent controls. "Grand Blue" monsters this card points to gain 500 DEF during the Battle Phase. You can banish this card from the GY; Set 1 "Grand Blue" Spell directly from your Deck, or, if your opponent controls a card, you can add it to your hand instead. You can only use each effect of "Oracle of the Grand Blue" once per turn.

candidates.name: Glint the Blackbird Aerocat
candidates.text: You can discard this card; add 1 "Aerocat" Spell/Trap card from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Aerocat" monster you control; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field, and if you do, increase that target's ATK by 500. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Rank 6 WIND Xyz Monster you control; attach this card from your hand or GY to that card as material. You can only use each effect of "Glint the Blackbird Aerocat" once per turn.

candidates.name: Release of the Pyre
candidates.text: If you control a Pyro monster: You can add 1 "Pyre" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You cannot Special Summon, except Pyro monsters. Once while this card is face-up on the field: You can target 1 "Pyre" Link monster you control in the Extra Monster Zone; while that monster points to an opponent's unused Main Monster Zone, your opponent cannot Special Summon monsters to the Extra Monster Zone (even if this card leaves the field). If a "Pyre" monster you control leaves the field because of an opponent's card or effect: You can draw 1 card, then send this card you control to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Release of the Pyre" once per turn.

candidates.name: World Legacy Surfacing
candidates.text: Reveal 1 Level 2 or lower "Krawler" monster in your hand or GY, or, if your opponent controls a card, you can reveal it from your Deck instead; this effect becomes that monster's FLIP effect when that monster is flipped face-up. You cannot activate other Spell/Trap Cards the turn you activate this effect, except "World Legacy" Spell/Trap Cards. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Krawler" monster and/or 1 "World Legacy" Spell/Trap from your GY or that is banished to your hand, except "World Legacy Surfacing". You can only use each effect of "World Legacy Surfacing" once per turn.
